data.name: Budail
data.gender_notes: Budail is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Budail is derived from the Arabic word ‘Budhla’ which means ‘firm, steadfast, determined, and resolute.’ It is a powerful name that represents strength, courage, and unwavering resolve. The name Budail carries the meaning “Firm, Steadfast, Determined” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Budail usually hope their child will grow to embody firm, steadfast, determined and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Budail is a reminder of the spiritual strength that lies within each one of us. It is a call to be steadfast in our faith and to never waver in our commitment to our beliefs.
data.etymology: Budail belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Firm, Steadfast, Determined.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Budail total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

He is believed to have been the first to migrate from Mecca to Medina, and played a significant role in the development of the Islamic community there.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari's Tarikh al-Rusul wa'l-Muluk (The History of Prophets and Kings) The name Budail carried significant weight in that era.
